# `tool-name-valid`

**Tool rule** · `error` · on by default

Tool names must be 1-128 characters of letters, digits, '_', '-' or '.'.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "tool-name-valid": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "tool-name-valid": "warning" } }); // change severity
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule tool-name-valid=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/tool-name-valid": "error" } }
```
